_twist: Inverted silt-amber dark palette to light: off-white parchment ground, deep charcoal text, warm greige accents. Amber-clay accent (#b85c2a) introduced as the sole chromatic color — a warm iron-oxide tone evoking aged nautical instrument casings.

visual.description: Warm parchment off-white — the primary page background. Inverted from silt-amber's near-black ground; the same temperature in light rather than dark register.
Warm linen — used for card and section surface backgrounds. Slightly deeper than the page ground to create subtle material layering.
Medium-warm stone — alternate surface for contrast-adjacent panels. Used in bento-grid cells and inset blocks.
Near-black warm charcoal for all headings. Deep enough for full contrast against parchment. Carries a faint warm-brown undertone — not pure black.
Dark warm greige for body copy. Softer than the heading text, creating a natural typographic hierarchy without a sharp contrast drop.
Medium warm greige for captions, metadata, and secondary labels. Sourced directly from silt-amber's muted greige family.
Amber-clay — a warm iron-oxide orange-brown. The system's sole chromatic color. Evokes the patinated brass and aged lacquer of precision nautical instruments.
Deeper amber-clay for interactive hover states on the accent color.
Warm greige border — used for structural dividers, table rules, and card outlines.
Light warm greige for subtle inner borders and inset field edges.
